title: VIX 3d spike precedes FDX drawdown
hypothesis: R2 | [fuel-airspace-losers] VIX 3-day pct change > 20 pct precedes freight and travel beta drawdowns (-); trade short FDX 2d at 1d lag [finance.^VIX.close -> finance.FDX.log_return]
message: Supported contemporaneously (r=-0.48, n=389, lag 0) but the 1d-lag short-FDX rule is weak: 51 trades, hit 49%, sharpe -0.25 overall; war-period OOS hit 70%, avg +0.20%/trade. Actionability 5.4.

trade_idea.entry_rule: finance.^VIX.close rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> short FDX next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 1 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.

followup_hypothesis: R2 | [fuel-airspace-losers] VIX daily log return spike predicts a next-day mean-reversion bounce in FedEx after panic selling (+); trade long FDX 1d at 1d lag [finance.^VIX.log_return -> finance.FDX.log_return] (parent: R2-0076)
